Name: EN_AUTO_RECOVERY_CONTROL_PARAM_ALL_TYPES_ST
Description: Controls automatic EN recovery for each AC state (idle, on the ground, in the air, boosting and so on). Each numbered entry is one state and sets the EN recharge rate, the EN upper and lower limits and whether the recovery delay is held.

Fields.Name: [Idle] Energy Recovery Rate
Fields.Description: EN recharge rate in this state, in percent. The EN recovery speed is multiplied by this value x 0.01.

Fields.Name: [Idle] Energy Max
Fields.Description: Upper limit of EN in this state, as a percentage of EN capacity.

Fields.Name: [Idle] Energy Min
Fields.Description: Lower limit of EN in this state, as a percentage of EN capacity. -1: use the system EN debt value.

Fields.Name: [Idle] Apply Energy Recovery Delay
Fields.Description: ON: keeps applying the EN recovery delay. OFF: does nothing (it does not force the delay to end).
